topic: Global Tiger Day and Tiger Conservation

subtopics.title: Global Initiatives: IUCN, NTCA Eco-Tourism and IBCA
subtopics.summary: The IUCN Integrated Tiger Habitat Conservation Programme supports habitat restoration, anti-poaching measures and community-led coexistence across Asia. The NTCA Eco-Tourism Initiative provides an integrated platform for authentic safari and accommodation bookings. The International Big Cat Alliance, launched in 2023, is an India-led effort covering seven big cat species.
facts: IUCN programme supports habitat restoration, anti-poaching and community-led coexistence
NTCA Eco-Tourism Initiative is an integrated platform for bookings
The platform covers authentic safari and accommodation bookings
International Big Cat Alliance was launched in 2023
The International Big Cat Alliance is India-led
It covers seven big cat species: Tiger, Lion, Leopard, Snow Leopard, Cheetah, Jaguar, Puma
1st International Big Cat Alliance Summit was scheduled for June 2026 in New Delhi and is marked postponed

subtopics.title: Indian Institutions and Conservation Milestones
subtopics.summary: The National Board for Wild Life is a statutory board under the Wild Life Protection Act, 1972, and works to promote conservation of wildlife and forests. Project Tiger, launched in 1973, is overseen by the National Tiger Conservation Authority, which conducts the tiger census along with the Wildlife Institute of India. The milestones run from the 1969 ban on export of wild cat skins to the 2023 launch of the International Big Cat Alliance.
facts: National Board for Wild Life is a statutory board under the Wild Life Protection Act, 1972
Project Tiger was launched in 1973 to support preservation of tigers in India
Project Tiger is overseen by the National Tiger Conservation Authority
Tiger census estimates population through a 4-year census cycle
Census is conducted by NTCA and the Wildlife Institute of India
M-STrIPES (2010) is a software-based monitoring system for tiger reserves
1969: ban on export of all wild cat skins
